response.description:
Azure HorizonDB supports
system-managed maintenance for planned service upgrades.With system-managed
maintenance, Azure HorizonDB automatically performs planned upgrades on your
cluster without requiring you to configure or manage a maintenance schedule.
This helps keep your cluster secure, reliable, and up to date while reducing
the operational overhead of managing routine service maintenance.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure HorizonDB System Managed Maintenance Window
